verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents broad CRM API coverage. That includes contacts create/manage, custom object records, the webhooks journal, account info, and an official MCP server with read/write access to CRM data. These endpoints come with per-endpoint OpenAPI specs and date-versioned releases. Many UI features in the pack, however, are documented only as UI tools with no API equivalent shown: workflows, sequences, reporting dashboards, imports, deduplication and connected inbox. There is also no explicit claim of UI–API parity. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for workflows, sequences, reports/dashboards, imports and dedup; an explicit parity commitment; independent hands-on corroboration.
